sentences.text: The petitioners have been seeking implementation of the directions of this Court whereby the respondents were directed to resort to the acquisition process.
2. The respondent No.3 who is the Sub-Divisional Officer and Special Land Acquisition Officer

in his affidavit-in-reply in paragraph No.5 has expressly mentioned that the process of land acquisition had commenced, declaration under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 was issued on 29.04.2022 and the process was at the stage of Section 19.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: He has further stated that the next stages would be completed and the final award would be passed in the time schedule prescribed under the statute.
This affidavit was filed in the month of August 2022.
Learned AGP on instructions submits that already notification under Section 19 has been issued in the last month.
3. In view of such commitment nothing survives.
The Contempt Petition is disposed of.
